correctness.rationale: The construction places a single binary chip at each chain origin and one at each target in first facet. Every auxiliary chain is degree-one and fires at its unique predetermined round t. For every t, each target receives at most one chip and its firing set is exactly F_t, while auxiliary vertices p_(j,v,t) with j>t fire once. Thus sigma_t=F_t ∪ {p_(j,v,t):j>t}; all auxiliary vertices belong to a unique generating simplex and are dominated by an anchor in F_t. Deleting them gives compatible stagewise strong collapses to every K_r; homology persistence is natural over any ring. The ten listed RP2 triangles give the integer Smith diagonal [1]^9,2 and H1=Z/2; node/chip counts 142 and 30 match formula. Domain: nonempty finite K, arbitrary facet order, parallel sink-excluded firing, binary initial data. Independent small examples checked; not a proof by enumeration.
